name: WLF_ATTEMPT_RELATIONS
description: Table to store attempt relations with tasks,assignments and learning items

columns.name: ATTEMPT_RELATION_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier.

columns.name: ATTEMPT_ID
columns.description: Refers to root attempt id of attempts table

columns.name: ATTEMPT_TYPE
columns.description: Refers to attempt type of attempts table

columns.name: ATTEMPTED_BY_ID
columns.description: Refers to attempt owner id

columns.name: ATTEMPTED_BY_TYPE
columns.description: Attempts owner type like learner , admin , system

columns.name: ATTEMPT_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Creation date of attempt relation

columns.name: ATTEMPT_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Refers to attempt completion date

columns.name: RELATED_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Refers to related object like task,assignment identifier

columns.name: RELATED_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Refers to type of related object like task or assignment

columns.name: LEARNING_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Refers to learning item on which relation entry is added

columns.name: LEARNING_ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the learning item

columns.name: LEARNER_ID
columns.description: Learner Id of the learning item

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the attempt , could be FAILED or COMPLETED

columns.name: ATTEMPT_OUTCOME
columns.description: Column to store attempt outcome when saving (before submit).

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SCORE
columns.description: Learner score for the attempt

columns.name: EFFORT_SEC
columns.description: Effort spent by learner in seconds

columns.name: ATTEMPT_RELATION_NUMBER
columns.description: UserKey to uniquely identify attempt (on content) relation with assignment task.
